functions.controlOwner: The source AI platform and its native governance service
functions.query:
let queryStartTime = iff(isnull(starttime), ago(14d), starttime);
let queryEndTime = iff(isnull(endtime), now(), endtime);
_Im_AgentEvent(starttime=queryStartTime, endtime=queryEndTime)
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    EventStartTime,
    EventEndTime,
    IngestionTime = ingestion_time(),
    EventUid,
    EventOriginalUid,
    EventType,
    EventOriginalType,
    EventResult,
    EventResultDetails,
    ActorUsername,
    ActorUserId,
    ActingAppId,
    ActingAppName,
    SrcAgentId,
    SrcAgentName,
    TargetAgentId,
    TargetAgentName,
    PlatformTargetAgentId,
    PlatformTargetAgentName,
    ModelProviderName,
    ModelName,
    ToolId,
    ToolName,
    EventSessionId,
    EventRequestId,
    EventResponseId,
    EventProduct,
    EventVendor,

| extend

    AuthoritativeControlOwner = "Source AI platform; Microsoft Sentinel ASIM provides normalization",

functions.controlOwner: Each source product owns its telemetry; Microsoft Sentinel owns workspace ingestion health
functions.query:
let healthWindow = iff(isnull(lookback), 24h, lookback);
let expected = datatable(
    TableName:string,
    AuthoritativeControlOwner:string,
    NativePortalRoute:string,
    RequiredForMvp:bool,
    ExpectedFreshness:timespan
)
[
    "CopilotActivity", "Microsoft Purview Audit / Microsoft 365 audit", "https://purview.microsoft.com/audit", true, 6h,
    "SecurityAlert", "Originating Microsoft Defender, Entra, or Purview alert provider", "https://security.microsoft.com/alerts", true, 2h,
    "SecurityIncident", "Microsoft Sentinel investigation container", "https://portal.azure.com/#view/Microsoft_Azure_Security_Insights/WorkspaceSelectorBlade", true, 2h,
    "SigninLogs", "Microsoft Entra ID", "https://entra.microsoft.com/#view/Microsoft_AAD_UsersAndTenants/UserManagementMenuBlade/~/SignIns", true, 2h,
    "AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs", "Microsoft Entra ID", "https://entra.microsoft.com/#view/Microsoft_AAD_UsersAndTenants/UserManagementMenuBlade/~/SignIns", false, 2h,
    "AuditLogs", "Microsoft Entra ID", "https://entra.microsoft.com/#view/Microsoft_AAD_IAM/ActiveDirectoryMenuBlade/~/Audit", true, 4h,
    "IdentityInfo", "Microsoft Defender XDR", "https://security.microsoft.com/", false, 24h,
    "CloudAppEvents", "Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps", "https://security.microsoft.com/cloudapps", false, 4h,
    "AlertInfo", "Microsoft Defender XDR", "https://security.microsoft.com/alerts", false, 2h,
    "AlertEvidence", "Microsoft Defender XDR", "https://security.microsoft.com/alerts", false, 2h,
    "DeviceEvents", "Microsoft Defender for Endpoint", "https://security.microsoft.com/advanced-hunting", false, 4h,
    "IdentityLogonEvents", "Microsoft Defender for Identity / Defender XDR", "https://security.microsoft.com/advanced-hunting", false, 4h,
    "IdentityDirectoryEvents", "Microsoft Defender for Identity / Defender XDR", "https://security.microsoft.com/advanced-hunting", false, 4h,
    "IdentityQueryEvents", "Microsoft Defender for Identity / Defender XDR", "https://security.microsoft.com/advanced-hunting", false, 4h,
    "MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection", "Microsoft Purview Information Protection", "https://purview.microsoft.com/", false, 24h,
    "OfficeActivity", "Microsoft Purview Audit / Microsoft 365 workloads", "https://purview.microsoft.com/audit", true, 6h,
    "EnrichedMicrosoft365AuditLogs", "Microsoft Purview Audit", "https://purview.microsoft.com/audit", false, 6h,
    "NetworkAccessGenerativeAIInsights", "Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access (preview)", "https://entra.microsoft.com/", false, 6h
];
let observed =
    union isfuzzy=true
    (CopilotActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(healthWindow) | project TableName="CopilotActivity", TimeGenerated),
    (SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated > ago(healthWindow) | project TableName="SecurityAlert", TimeGenerated),
    (SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated > ago(healthWindow) | project TableName="SecurityIncident", TimeGenerated),
    (SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(healthWindow) | project TableName="SigninLogs", TimeGenerated),
    (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(healthWindow) | project TableName="AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs", TimeGenerated),
    (AuditLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(healthWindow) | project TableName="AuditLogs", TimeGenerated),
    (IdentityInfo | where TimeGenerated > ago(healthWindow) | project TableName="IdentityInfo", TimeGenerated),
    (CloudAppEvents | where TimeGenerated > ago(healthWindow) | project TableName="CloudAppEvents", TimeGenerated),
    (AlertInfo | where TimeGenerated > ago(healthWindow) | project TableName="AlertInfo", TimeGenerated),
    (AlertEvidence | where TimeGenerated > ago(healthWindow) | project TableName="AlertEvidence", TimeGenerated),
    (DeviceEvents | where TimeGenerated > ago(healthWindow) | project TableName="DeviceEvents", TimeGenerated),
    (IdentityLogonEvents | where TimeGenerated > ago(healthWindow) | project TableName="IdentityLogonEvents", TimeGenerated),
    (IdentityDirectoryEvents | where TimeGenerated > ago(healthWindow) | project TableName="IdentityDirectoryEvents", TimeGenerated),
    (IdentityQueryEvents | where TimeGenerated > ago(healthWindow) | project TableName="IdentityQueryEvents", TimeGenerated),
    (MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection | where TimeGenerated > ago(healthWindow) | project TableName="MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection", TimeGenerated),
    (OfficeActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(healthWindow) | project TableName="OfficeActivity", TimeGenerated),
    (EnrichedMicrosoft365AuditLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(healthWindow) | project TableName="EnrichedMicrosoft365AuditLogs", TimeGenerated),
    (NetworkAccessGenerativeAIInsights | where TimeGenerated > ago(healthWindow) | project TableName="NetworkAccessGenerativeAIInsights", TimeGenerated),
    (datatable(TableName:string, TimeGenerated:datetime)[])
    | summarize LastEventTime=max(TimeGenerated), EventCount=count() by TableName;
expected
| join kind=leftouter observed on TableName
| extend
    Age = now() - LastEventTime,
    Status = case(
        isnull(LastEventTime), "UnavailableOrSilent",
        Age > ExpectedFreshness, "Stale",
        "Healthy"),
    GovernanceFunction = "M365Gov_DataHealth"
| project-away TableName1

functions.controlOwner: Originating Microsoft security or compliance product
functions.query:
let alertLookback = iff(isnull(starttime), ago(14d), starttime);
let alertEnd = iff(isnull(endtime), now(), endtime);
union isfuzzy=true
(
    SecurityAlert
    | where TimeGenerated between (alertLookback .. alertEnd)
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        IngestionTime = ingestion_time(),
        SourceTable = "SecurityAlert",
        NativeRecordId = tostring(SystemAlertId),
        NativeIncidentNumber = "",
        AlertName = tostring(AlertName),
        AlertSeverity = tostring(AlertSeverity),
        AlertStatus = tostring(AlertStatus),
        ProductName = tostring(ProductName),
        ProviderName = tostring(ProviderName),
        AuthoritativeControlOwner = case(
            ProductName has "Entra" or ProviderName has "Entra", "Microsoft Entra",
            ProductName has "Purview" or ProviderName has "Purview", "Microsoft Purview",
            ProductName has "Defender" or ProviderName has "Defender", "Microsoft Defender",
            "Source product represented by the native alert"),
        ActorIdentifier = tostring(CompromisedEntity),
        TenantIdentifier = tostring(TenantId),
        NativePortalRoute = "https://security.microsoft.com/alerts",
        SourceDescription = tostring(Description)
),
(
    SecurityIncident
    | where TimeGenerated between (alertLookback .. alertEnd)
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        IngestionTime = ingestion_time(),
        SourceTable = "SecurityIncident",
        NativeRecordId = tostring(IncidentName),
        NativeIncidentNumber = tostring(IncidentNumber),
        AlertName = tostring(Title),
        AlertSeverity = tostring(Severity),
        AlertStatus = tostring(Status),
        ProductName = "Microsoft Sentinel incident",
        ProviderName = tostring(ProviderName),
        AuthoritativeControlOwner = "Microsoft Sentinel (incident container); originating products retain control ownership",
        ActorIdentifier = "",
        TenantIdentifier = tostring(TenantId),
        NativePortalRoute = "https://portal.azure.com/#view/Microsoft_Azure_Security_Insights/WorkspaceSelectorBlade",
        SourceDescription = tostring(Description)
)
| where isnotempty(NativeRecordId)
| extend GovernanceFunction = "M365Gov_NativeAlerts"

analytics.displayName: M365 Governance - Cross-Product Native Alert Correlation
analytics.description: Correlation requires the same non-empty CompromisedEntity representation. A shared entity does not prove a common root cause. The rule does not reproduce native alert logic or inspect prompt content.
analytics.query:
let correlationWindow = 1h;
let alerts =
    M365Gov_NativeAlerts(ago(1d), now())
    | where SourceTable == "SecurityAlert"
    | where isnotempty(ActorIdentifier)
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        NativeRecordId,
        AlertName,
        AlertSeverity,
        ProductName,
        ProviderName,
        AuthoritativeControlOwner,
        ActorIdentifier,
        NativePortalRoute;
alerts
| join kind=inner alerts on ActorIdentifier
| where NativeRecordId < NativeRecordId1
| where abs(datetime_diff("minute", TimeGenerated, TimeGenerated1)) <= toint(correlationWindow / 1m)
| where ProductName != ProductName1 or ProviderName != ProviderName1
| extend
    AlertTitle = "Cross-product native alert correlation",
    AlertDescription = "Two existing native alerts from different product or provider contexts reference the same compromised entity within one hour. Investigate in each authoritative native portal.",
    AccountCustomEntity = ActorIdentifier
| project
    TimeGenerated=max_of(TimeGenerated, TimeGenerated1),
    AlertTitle,
    AlertDescription,
    ActorIdentifier,
    FirstAlertId=NativeRecordId,
    FirstAlertName=AlertName,
    FirstSeverity=AlertSeverity,
    FirstProduct=ProductName,
    FirstProvider=ProviderName,
    FirstOwner=AuthoritativeControlOwner,
    FirstPortal=NativePortalRoute,
    SecondAlertId=NativeRecordId1,
    SecondAlertName=AlertName1,
    SecondSeverity=AlertSeverity1,
    SecondProduct=ProductName1,
    SecondProvider=ProviderName1,
    SecondOwner=AuthoritativeControlOwner1,
    SecondPortal=NativePortalRoute1,
    AccountCustomEntity

analytics.displayName: M365 Governance - Required Data Source Silence
analytics.controlOwner: Microsoft Sentinel operations for connector health; source products own telemetry
analytics.description: UnavailableOrSilent can mean absent, unauthorized, unlicensed, disabled, or no events. A stale source may be normal for a quiet tenant. This analytic reports health only and does not infer misconduct or risk.
analytics.query:
M365Gov_DataHealth(24h)
| where RequiredForMvp
| where Status in ("UnavailableOrSilent", "Stale")
| extend
    AlertTitle = strcat("M365 governance data source ", Status, ": ", TableName),
    AlertDescription = strcat(
        "The required native source is ", Status,
        ". This is an operational-health signal, not evidence that no security, compliance, identity, or AI activity occurred. Validate the connector, licensing, permissions, and native portal."),
    SourceCustomEntity = TableName
| project
    TimeGenerated=now(),
    AlertTitle,
    AlertDescription,
    TableName,
    Status,
    LastEventTime,
    Age,
    ExpectedFreshness,
    EventCount,
    AuthoritativeControlOwner,
    NativePortalRoute,
    SourceCustomEntity

analytics.displayName: M365 Governance - Native Alert and Risky Identity Correlation
analytics.description: Matching requires a native alert CompromisedEntity equal to ASIM ActorUsername. Different identity formats or missing entities prevent correlation. AI activity or usage volume is never promoted to identity risk.
analytics.query:
let correlationWindow = 6h;
let nativeRiskAlerts =
    M365Gov_NativeAlerts(ago(1d), now())
    | where ProductName has_any ("Entra", "Identity Protection")
        or ProviderName has_any ("Entra", "Identity Protection")
        or AlertName has_any ("risky user", "risky sign-in", "identity risk")
    | where isnotempty(ActorIdentifier)
    | project
        RiskAlertTime=TimeGenerated,
        RiskAlertId=NativeRecordId,
        RiskAlertName=AlertName,
        RiskAlertSeverity=AlertSeverity,
        ActorIdentifier,
        ProductName,
        ProviderName,
        NativePortalRoute;
let aiActivity =
    M365Gov_AiActivity(ago(1d), now())
    | where isnotempty(ActorUsername)
    | project
        AiActivityTime=TimeGenerated,
        ActorUsername,
        SrcAgentName,
        TargetAgentName,
        ActingAppName,
        AiEventType=EventType,
        AiEventUid=EventUid;
nativeRiskAlerts
| join kind=innerunique aiActivity on $left.ActorIdentifier == $right.ActorUsername
| where AiActivityTime between (RiskAlertTime - correlationWindow .. RiskAlertTime + correlationWindow)
| extend
    AlertTitle = "Native identity-risk alert correlated with AI activity",
    AlertDescription = strcat("A native Microsoft Entra identity-risk alert was observed near normalized AI activity. Validate and remediate identity risk in Microsoft Entra; use Sentinel only for correlation."),
    AccountCustomEntity = ActorUsername
| project
    TimeGenerated=max_of(RiskAlertTime, AiActivityTime),
    AlertTitle,
    AlertDescription,
    RiskAlertId,
    RiskAlertName,
    RiskAlertSeverity,
    ProductName,
    ProviderName,
    ActorUsername,
    SrcAgentName,
    TargetAgentName,
    ActingAppName,
    AiEventType,
    AiEventUid,
    NativePortalRoute,
    AccountCustomEntity
